tasks.name: Cloudflare Workers Access Control — Signed URLs for Private Video
Video Upload Pipeline — Livepeer Transcode + R2 Storage
tasks.prompt:
TASK T04: Create the production video upload pipeline: raw video → Livepeer transcode → Cloudflare R2 storage → Arweave metadata.

Context: This replaces the Arweave-direct upload in useArweaveUpload.ts with the correct ADR-compliant pipeline.

FILE TO CREATE: /home/dino/Decentralflix/apps/frontend/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts

The hook manages a 4-step pipeline:

STEP 1 — Livepeer Transcode:
- Accept File or URL input
- POST to Livepeer Asset API: https://livepeer.studio/api/asset/upload (with NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVEPEER_API_KEY)
- Poll asset status until 'ready'
- Get playbackId and downloadUrl for each quality level
- Simulation mode if no API key: fake realistic timings + generate fake-but-valid-looking playbackId

STEP 2 — Upload HLS to Cloudflare R2:
- R2 upload via presigned URL from backend (never expose R2 credentials to frontend)
- Call /api/upload/r2-presign endpoint to get presigned upload URL
- Upload HLS manifest + segments to R2 private bucket
- Get the R2 object key for each segment
- Simulation mode: return fake R2 keys

STEP 3 — Arweave Metadata Only:
- Build metadata JSON: {title, description, genre, creator, r2Key, livepeerPlaybackId, thumbnailHash, tierPrices, timestamp}
- Upload metadata JSON to Arweave (use existing useArweaveUpload for this)
- Get Arweave transaction ID
- Also store on Filecoin via web3.storage or NFT.storage (simulation ok)

STEP 4 — On-Chain Registration:
- Return all pointers for the caller to pass to mintFilm contract call
- {r2Key, livepeerPlaybackId, arweaveMetadataTxId, filecoinCid}

EXPORTED TYPE:
```ts
export type UploadResult = {
  r2Key: string
  livepeerPlaybackId: string
  arweaveMetadataTxId: string
  filecoinCid: string
  isSimulation: boolean
}

export type UploadProgress = {
  step: 1|2|3|4
  stepName: string
  percent: number
  message: string
}

export function useVideoUpload(): {
  upload: (file: File, metadata: FilmMetadataInput) => Promise<UploadResult>
  progress: UploadProgress | null
  error: string | null
  isUploading: boolean
}
```
